causal_limitations: Cumulative versus fresh D02 compares workflow plus prior research/feedback, not reuse alone.
Unequal final effort is not a fixed-budget causal comparison.
Two replicated trajectories remain a small, correlated scientific population.
Model/math review is not full Lean or source-first PV.

checkpoint_selection.active_snapshot_rule: The periodic60-second active snapshots are non-atomic. Their existence or internal metadata alone does not establish a complete or mathematically validated checkpoint.
checkpoint_selection.creator: ROOT explicit owner-directed analysis policy, implemented by protocol peer
checkpoint_selection.cutoff_rule: Latest fully hash-consistent own source/evidence checkpoint whose authoritative accounted cumulative generated research tokens are <= the target. Never choose at/after a target or use later proof/source/certificate information.
checkpoint_selection.population: Every completed arm/stage/control in the declared follow-up, including negative/unassessed/interrupted records; not only successes.
checkpoint_selection.required_closure: For a milestone claim, bind exact source, definitions, proof, numerical certificate coverage/tail, inputs and pre-cutoff receipts needed by that claim. If a later artifact or premise is essential, do not backdate it.
checkpoint_selection.selection_quality_independence: Choose the temporal eligible checkpoint mechanically before assessing its mathematical strength; do not select an earlier prettier checkpoint or change arm checkpoint criteria.

extension_parity: Every treatment may continue without a mathematical hard cap. Control opportunity must remain comparable to actual paired workflow extensions; milestone size is recording granularity, not outcome exclusion.
fresh_D02_control: Initial1,000,000research-token planning opportunity corresponding to paired500,000+500,000; further250,000 planning increments while meaningful work remains. No inherited D01 artifacts, no requirement to rediscover the paired floor, no forced consumption of unused allowance.
later_results: Retain and assess all later valid mathematics separately. Passing a target does not terminate research or invalidate output.
mathematical_assessment: Independent final reviewers may trace the earliest exact already-closed proof/certificate among pre-cutoff materials and replay the strongest closed checkpoint subsets when material. No blanket huge additional checkpoint-review cohort is required. Until actual closure checks pass, report unavailable or unassessed; do not invent best-result curves from self-reports.
paired_workflow: Cumulative research generation across the same arm/replication D01 then D02, including own repair and resumed sessions. Preserve D01 review/repair temporal order and own-only inheritance.
research_and_review_accounting: Record research generated/input/cache tokens, wall/time/tool use and review/repair effort separately. Report total workflow effort and acknowledge that intermediate feedback also costs inference. Research-only curves are not equal-total-cost causal claims.
source_ordering_disclosure: Prepared after the first three research stages actually started. No submitted mathematical outcome or relative arm result was read to choose checkpoints. This is not a claim of a prelaunch preregistration.
